knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "The Fred & Pamela Buffett Cancer Center has begun changing forever the way cancer is diagnosed and treated. By using the most advanced biomedical and technological tools available, we are increasingly identifying the drivers behind cancer and creating precise therapies that improve outcomes. Through the use of genomics and other new diagnostic tools, we are employing precision medicine to customize therapies and care for each cancer patient."
